text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. President Bill Clinton says mission achieved while explosions in central Baghdad reported.
- Israel plans to build 10,000 houses as Jewish settlements in the Golan.
- Arab foreign ministers meet on September 13. Frantic Israeli moves in the U.S. to convince Washington to abandon the land-for-peace principle.
- A european delegation in Damascus to discuss European-Mediterranean partnership.
- Ministers of the Gulf Cooperation Council discuss on Saturday developments of the peace process.
- Lebanon renews rejection to Israeli proposal and stresses national and strategic ties with Syria.
- Syria's Baath ruling party hold talks with Czeck communist party over cooperation and peace developments.

- Syria's speech in the meeting of the non-aligned members says: "Continuation of the Israeli occupation of Arab lands and the American attack on Iraq exposes the region to dangers and struggles that threaten peace."
